invisible: Wind is invisible, but we can see the leaves move.
Thick fog made the hills behind school invisible.
In hide and seek, I wished I was invisible!
impolite: I forgot to say please, which was impolite of me.
Interrupting someone who is talking is impolite.
Is it impolite to leave without saying goodbye?
inactive: After the big lunch, the dog lay inactive on the rug.
The hamster stays inactive in the day and runs at night.
Don't stay inactive, come and play football with us!
impatient: I was impatient for my birthday to come.
Waiting for the cake to bake made us all impatient!
Are you impatient to open your present?
illegal: Keeping a pet badger is illegal, because the law protects wild animals.
Did you know that the law makes picking some wild flowers illegal?
Because the law forbids it, dumping rubbish here is illegal.
imperfect: This apple has a tiny mark on it, so it is imperfect.
Is the vase imperfect because of the chip on its rim?
The cake sank in the middle, so it was imperfect but tasty.
impossible: It is impossible to count every star in the sky.
The jar lid was stuck so tight that opening it seemed impossible.
Mum said it was impossible to be in two places at once.
irregular: The tiles on the path are irregular, some big and some small.
The bus comes at irregular times, so we never know when.
The rocks on the beach are irregular, not round like balls.
illogical: Putting your shoes on before your socks is illogical.
Watering the garden during a downpour is illogical!
The story was illogical, because the cat flew and nobody was surprised.
irresponsible: It was irresponsible of me to forget to feed the rabbit.
Leaving the tap running all day is irresponsible.
Why was it irresponsible to leave the paint tin open?
